note: Looping positional emitters at map features. 'bed' names an existing ambience bed (data/audio/ambience.json) whose synth is the loop, so no new sound asset ships. Distances are in cells; metres = cells * cell_metres. Attenuation is the AudioStreamPlayer3D fit in cues/positional.rs. 'features' maps a terrain/feature id to its emitter kind.
